# Known answers for the installer samples.
# Tools: osslsigncode 2.14, gsf version 1.14.53, file-5.47, Python 3.14.8
# Date: 2026-10-08
# fingerprint <sample> <sha256>: osslsigncode "Calculated DigitalSignature" for the sample with its
#   signature (and extended stream) removed: osslsigncode remove-signature, sign the bare package with a
#   throw-away certificate, osslsigncode verify. It is the digest of the contents; it does not depend on
#   the sector size or on where the signature is.
# entries <sample> <count> <signature size|none>: gsf list entries below the root, and the size gsf
#   reports for the DigitalSignature stream.
# file <sample> <kind>: whether file(1) reports an installer.
# stored-digest / stored-ex <sample> <sha256>: osslsigncode "Current DigitalSignature" and
#   "Current MsiDigitalSignatureEx", the values held in the signature of a signed sample (the
#   extended value covers the extended stream, so the digest of a package that has one differs
#   from its fingerprint).
# blob <name> <size> <sha256>: bytes written by make_cfb.py --blob <name> <size>.
# Input SHA-256 of every sample follows.
